00259 /**
00260  * @brief               Get the selected filename
00261  *
00262  * HxListGetSelection returns the selected filename, and whether the selection
00263  * is a directory.
00264  *
00265  * The index is based on the count returned by HxFileListGetSelectionCount.
00266  * For example, if HxFileListGetSelectionCount returns a count of 2, index 0
00267  * returns the first selected file, while index 1 returns the second selected
00268  * file.
00269  *
00270  * The application should set *pBytes to the size of the buffer passed.  
00271  * If *pBytes is less than the size required, HX_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL is returned,
00272  * and *pBytes is set to the size of the buffer required.
00273  *
00274  * If pFilename is set to NULL, *pBytes is set to the size of the buffer
00275  * required, and HX_OK is returned.
00276  *
00277  * @param pFileList     IN:     Pointer to file list
00278  * @param index         IN:     Index of the selected item to return
00279  * @param pFilename     IN:     Buffer for the filename string, or NULL
00280  * @param pBytes        IN/OUT: Pointer to the size of the character buffer.
00281  *                              If buffer is too small returns the required
00282  *                              minimum buffer size
00283  * @param pIsDirectory  OUT:    Boolean flag set to true if returned filename
00284  *                              is a directory; can be set to NULL
00285  *
00286  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK on success. Returns
00287  *                              HX_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL if buffer is not large
00288  *                              enough for file name.
00289  *
00290  **/
00291 HxResult HxFileListGetSelection(HxFileList_t* pFileList, int32_t index, 
00292                                 char* pFilename, int32_t* pBytes,
00293                                 bool* pIsDirectory);
